comparison.objective: Candidate commissions an industrial shock absorber; pr-1160 rinses highlighted teeth, evacuates water, and returns both dental tools.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses a hex key and collar with iterative mechanical cycling. pr-1160 coordinates two tools continuously, sweeps crown regions, positions suction relative to pooled water, withdraws the irrigator, and returns both tools.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires bounded impact energy/velocity, no bottoming or excessive rebound, and a retained setting. pr-1160 requires region coverage and delivered volume, at least 90% recovery, strict spill and residual-water limits, a suction-clear interval, and both tools returned and released.
comparison.reason: Coordinated fluid delivery and evacuation has no meaningful objective or outcome overlap with mechanical damping adjustment; its lumped fluid model also tests a different physical regime.
